children: Credo Technology Group reported first-quarter fiscal 2027 results with revenue of $479.0 million and GAAP net income of $129.4 million for the quarter ended August 1, 2026. GAAP gross margin was 64.5% while non-GAAP diluted net income per share was $1.20. The company announced second-quarter revenue guidance of $525 million to $535 million and provided accompanying margin and operating expense ranges.
Revenue: $479.0 million for the three months ended August 1, 2026 (up 114.7% year over year; up 9.6% quarter over quarter).
Gross profit: $309.1 million; GAAP gross margin 64.5% and non-GAAP gross margin 68.0%.
Operating income: GAAP operating income $120.7 million.
Net income: GAAP net income $129.4 million; GAAP diluted net income per share $0.67; non-GAAP net income $236.3 million and non-GAAP diluted net income per share $1.20.
Cash and short-term investments: Ending balance $764.3 million.
Portfolio breadth: Offers connectivity solutions spanning optics and copper, addressing links from millimeters to kilometers across data center applications.

Product focus: Continued emphasis on energy-efficient interconnect products including ZeroFlap active electrical cables and optical transceivers, silicon photonics PICs and DSPs, OmniConnect memory and chip-to-chip interconnect, and retimers for Ethernet and PCIe.
Market positioning: Management highlighted momentum driven by scaling AI infrastructure demand and the company’s vertically integrated connectivity portfolio.
Software support: PILOT diagnostic and analytics platform supports product deployments and system-level diagnostics.
